Task: Text Content Safety

Write code that flags or redacts unsafe spans from text using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Alibaba Content Moderation:
  Service: Alibaba Content Moderation
  SDK: alibabacloud_green
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: text/scan
  Setup hints: ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_ID, ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/doc-detail/331920.html

Option 2 — Perspective API:
  Service: Perspective API
  SDK: requests
  Interface: rest
  Documented operations: comments:analyze
  Setup hints: PERSPECTIVE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://developers.perspectiveapi.com/s/

Option 3 — Tisane:
  Service: Tisane Text Moderation
  SDK: requests
  Interface: rest
  Documented operations: POST /parse
  Setup hints: TISANE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.tisane.ai/

Option 4 — watsonx guardrails:
  Service: watsonx.ai guardrails / HAP detection
  SDK: ibm-watsonx-ai / REST
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: HAP detection, text detection
  Setup hints: WATSONX_API_KEY, WATSONX_PROJECT_ID
  Official docs: https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/watsonxdata/premium/2.3.x?topic=prompts-removing-harmful-content

Option 5 — Azure AI Content Safety:
  Service: Azure AI Content Safety
  SDK: requests / azure-ai-contentsafety
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: analyze_text
  Setup hints: AZURE_CONTENT_SAFETY_ENDPOINT, AZURE_CONTENT_SAFETY_KEY
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/content-safety/overview

Option 6 — Amazon Comprehend Toxicity / Bedrock Guardrails:
  Service: Amazon Comprehend / Bedrock Guardrails
  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: detect_toxic_content, apply_guardrail
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/comprehend/latest/dg/trust-safety.html

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

output_text:
import os
import re
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple

import requests


PERSPECTIVE_API_HOST = "https://commentanalyzer.googleapis.com/v1alpha1/comments:analyze"
DEFAULT_ATTRIBUTES = [
    "TOXICITY",
    "SEVERE_TOXICITY",
    "INSULT",
    "PROFANITY",
    "THREAT",
    "IDENTITY_ATTACK",
]
DEFAULT_SPAN_THRESHOLD = 0.7
DEFAULT_TEXT_THRESHOLD = 0.8


class PerspectiveSafetyError(RuntimeError):
    pass


def _get_api_key(api_key: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
    key = api_key or os.getenv("PERSPECTIVE_API_KEY")
    if not key:
        raise PerspectiveSafetyError("Missing Perspective API key: set PERSPECTIVE_API_KEY")
    return key


def _sentence_spans(text: str) -> List[Tuple[int, int]]:
    spans: List[Tuple[int, int]] = []
    for match in re.finditer(r"[^.!?\n]+[.!?]?\s*", text, flags=re.MULTILINE):
        start, end = match.span()
        if text[start:end].strip():
            spans.append((start, end))
    if not spans and text:
        spans.append((0, len(text)))
    return spans


def _clause_spans(text: str) -> List[Tuple[int, int]]:
    spans: List[Tuple[int, int]] = []
    for match in re.finditer(r"[^,;:\n]+[,;:]?\s*", text, flags=re.MULTILINE):
        start, end = match.span()
        if text[start:end].strip():
            spans.append((start, end))
    if not spans and text:
        spans.append((0, len(text)))
    return spans


def _merge_spans(spans: List[Tuple[int, int]]) -> List[Tuple[int, int]]:
    if not spans:
        return []
    spans = sorted(spans)
    merged = [spans[0]]
    for start, end in spans[1:]:
        last_start, last_end = merged[-1]
        if start <= last_end:
            merged[-1] = (last_start, max(last_end, end))
        else:
            merged.append((start, end))
    return merged


def _redact_text(text: str, spans: List[Tuple[int, int]], replacement: str = "[REDACTED]") -> str:
    if not spans:
        return text
    parts: List[str] = []
    last = 0
    for start, end in _merge_spans(spans):
        parts.append(text[last:start])
        parts.append(replacement)
        last = end
    parts.append(text[last:])
    return "".join(parts)


def _analyze_text(
    text: str,
    api_key: str,
    attributes: List[str],
    session: Optional[requests.Session] = None,
    timeout: int = 30,
    language: str = "en",
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    requester = session or requests
    payload = {
        "comment": {"text": text},
        "requestedAttributes": {attr: {} for attr in attributes},
        "languages": [language],
        "doNotStore": True,
    }
    response = requester.post(
        PERSPECTIVE_API_HOST,
        params={"key": api_key},
        json=payload,
        timeout=timeout,
    )
    if response.status_code != 200:
        raise PerspectiveSafetyError(f"Perspective API error {response.status_code}: {response.text}")
    return response.json()


def _extract_attribute_scores(result: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, float]:
    scores: Dict[str, float] = {}
    for attr, body in result.get("attributeScores", {}).items():
        value = (
            body.get("summaryScore", {}).get("value")
            if isinstance(body, dict)
            else None
        )
        if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
            scores[attr] = float(value)
    return scores


def _max_score(scores: Dict[str, float]) -> float:
    return max(scores.values()) if scores else 0.0


def flag_or_redact_unsafe_text(
    text: str,
    mode: str = "flag",
    api_key: Optional[str] = None,
    attributes: Optional[List[str]] = None,
    text_threshold: float = DEFAULT_TEXT_THRESHOLD,
    span_threshold: float = DEFAULT_SPAN_THRESHOLD,
    replacement: str = "[REDACTED]",
    language: str = "en",
    timeout: int = 30,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    if mode not in {"flag", "redact"}:
        raise ValueError("mode must be 'flag' or 'redact'")

    api_key = _get_api_key(api_key)
    attributes = attributes or DEFAULT_ATTRIBUTES

    document_result = _analyze_text(
        text=text,
        api_key=api_key,
        attributes=attributes,
        timeout=timeout,
        language=language,
    )
    document_scores = _extract_attribute_scores(document_result)
    document_max = _max_score(document_scores)
    overall_unsafe = document_max >= text_threshold

    candidate_spans = _merge_spans(_sentence_spans(text) + _clause_spans(text))
    unsafe_spans: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []

    for start, end in candidate_spans:
        segment = text[start:end]
        if not segment.strip():
            continue
        segment_result = _analyze_text(
            text=segment,
            api_key=api_key,
            attributes=attributes,
            timeout=timeout,
            language=language,
        )
        segment_scores = _extract_attribute_scores(segment_result)
        segment_max = _max_score(segment_scores)
        if segment_max >= span_threshold:
            unsafe_spans.append(
                {
                    "start": start,
                    "end": end,
                    "text": segment,
                    "scores": segment_scores,
                    "max_score": segment_max,
                }
            )

    redacted_text = _redact_text(
        text,
        [(s["start"], s["end"]) for s in unsafe_spans],
        replacement=replacement,
    ) if mode == "redact" else text

    return {
        "provider": "Perspective API",
        "endpoint": PERSPECTIVE_API_HOST,
        "mode": mode,
        "text": redacted_text,
        "overall_unsafe": overall_unsafe,
        "document_scores": document_scores,
        "document_max_score": document_max,
        "unsafe_spans": unsafe_spans,
    }
